title: Release-notes runway, stakeholder handoff matrix, and catalog activation checklist for new model entry
creator: Maya Chen
description:
Purpose: Deliver an end-to-end runway and stakeholder approval matrix that coordinates release notes, benchmark publication, docs updates, and external comms for a single new model addition to Redwood's catalog. This ticket produces: (1) a finalized release notes artifact ready for publication, (2) a stakeholder signoff checklist (engineering, research, QA, docs, legal, marketing, support), (3) a gated activation checklist used by Launch Ops to flip the catalog exposure from internal to public, and (4) a short rollback/runback plan if post-release regressions are observed.

Scope: Applies to catalog additions where a model is public-facing (hosted API) or listed as a Dedicated/Private offering. Excludes experimental internal-only canaries covered under PM-31654.

Acceptance criteria: 
- Release notes doc (markdown) completed and approved by PM, Research, Legal, and Marketing.
- Benchmark summary table (latency P50/P95, throughput @ 8k context, and quality evals) uploaded to Confluence link in artifacts.
- Docs changes merged (model spec + example prompts + migration notes) and shipped with a console feature flag if necessary.
- Announcement copy (internal short + customer-facing long + social excerpt) drafted and approved.
- Launch Ops checklist validated in a dry run with an engineer and release manager.

Deliverables (templates included in attachments):
- Release Notes Template (header, highlights, changes, performance, known issues, migration notes, support links)
- Stakeholder Handoff Matrix (who approves what, SLA for approvals, escalation path)
- Activation Gate Checklist (preflight tests, capacity gating, rollout plan, monitoring dashboard checks, rollback criteria)
- Post-release monitoring playbook (metrics, alert thresholds, responder roles)

Key timeline milestones: 
- T-14 days: Draft release notes + benchmark summary + docs PR opened.
- T-10 days: Internal review cycle complete (research/eng/design/legal).
- T-5 days: Marketing draft of announcement and customer-facing assets.
- T-2 days: Launch Ops dry run and monitoring dashboard bake-off.
- Launch day: Activation window and 72-hour high-touch monitoring.

Notes on coordination: Use the Stakeholder Handoff Matrix to enforce a 48-hour approval SLA for core signoffs (Research, Eng Owner, Legal). If any signoff is delayed beyond 48 hours, PD must escalate to Director of Product. Benchmarks must include the canonical eval set and cost-per-1000-tokens estimate for hosted vs. dedicated variants.

Communication channels: #product-launches (high level), #infra-ops (capacity), #model-evals (research signals), private launch Slack channel for launch window. All core artifacts live in Confluence at the linked Drive folder.

Rollout/rollback guardrails:
- Activation staged: 0% -> 10% -> 50% -> 100% traffic over 4 hours unless errors or latency regressions observed.
- Immediate rollback trigger: RPS error rate increase >3x baseline OR P95 latency increase >2x baseline for >5 minutes.
- Partial rollback: shift traffic to baseline model variant if available; otherwise full rollback.

Monitoring dashboard (required graphs):
- Token throughput and cost-per-1k-token (hosted + dedicated).
- Latency P50/P90/P95 by route and model variant.
- 5xx/4xx error rates and tail distribution.
- Request failure reasons (OOM/timeout/model-mismatch).
- Telemetry for regressions on quality (sampled outputs compared to golden set).

Quality gates for publishing benchmarks:
- Latency: P95 must be within target SLO for the planned tiers.
- Accuracy/Evals: No regression >3% absolute on prioritized eval set versus baseline.
- Cost: expected cost per 1k tokens documented and verified by infra finance owner.

post_release_tasks: Collect 72-hour monitoring summary, gather any customer support tickets related to the model, run a quality-sampling sweep on 500 random requests, update docs with any migration clarifications, debrief with cross-functional stakeholders and record learnings in Confluence.
notes_for_launch_ops: Ensure autoscaling policies for dedicated pools are active, set temporary increased retention for debug traces for 72 hours post-launch, enable verbose anomaly logging for first 6 hours, and keep on-call infra engineer assigned for the launch window.
estimated_risks: Known risk: conversational-turn-taking regression (research investigating). Operational risk: capacity oversubscription if a major customer routes traffic to the new model at launch. Mitigation: cap initial exposure to 10% and alert finance/ops on cost deviations.
